tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Yeḥezqel: ḥazaq, 'to strengthen', + El, 'God'. Its root is Hebrew ḥ-z-q-ʾ-l. The prophet Ezekiel; the Book of Ezekiel. Ezekiel is a Hebrew name meaning “God strengthens”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
